cohort: Singleton deliveries at a tertiary care hospital between 2011 and 2015, comprising 435 cases with pre-eclampsia matched to 435 controls without pre-eclampsia.
finding: A history of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) was not associated with the risk of pre-eclampsia in this study.
gest_age: Cases and controls were matched on gestational age week.
